work: Institutes of the Christian Religion, Book II, Chapter 8
heading: Institutes II.8 · Fifth Commandment · Section II.8.38

items.text: Honor your father and mother, showing them proper respect.
items.quote: children who show proper respect to their parents

items.text: Obey your parents only in the Lord; if they command you to sin, do not obey them, but regard them as strangers trying to lead you from God.
items.quote: We are ordered to obey parents only in the Lord... if they instigate us to transgress the law, they deserve not to be regarded as parents

work: Institutes of the Christian Religion, Book II, Chapter 8
heading: Institutes II.8 · Fifth Commandment … Section II.8.37

items.text: Obey your father and mother in all things, as those whom God has set over you.
items.quote: The second he enforces, when he denounces the punishment of death on disobedient and rebellious children.

items.text: Honor them with reverence, never cursing or despising them, for they bear God's authority.
items.quote: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land.

items.text: Do good to your parents, supplying their needs in return for the life they gave you.
items.quote: God requires us to do good to our parents (Mt. 15).
